meta.name: Hey Bhogoban
meta.description: Hey Bhogoban is a Bengali comedy movie starring Saurav Das, Rupsha Chakraborty, and Arindam Ganguly. The film revolves around Simpi, a young woman, who nurses a grudge against God after losing her parents in her childhood. However, despite being an atheist, she resorts to performing Pujas as means to earn her livelihood. To turn Simpi into a believer, Krishna, the chief among gods, sends his assistant Madan, the god of love. What transpires next is a hilarious chain of events that help a God and a human being bond and find new meaning to their existence.
